title: Safety near-miss silence
accepted_explanation: Employees do not understand the reporting system.
observations: Employees can correctly demonstrate how to file a near-miss report.
Teams with supervisors who discuss mistakes openly report more near misses.
Several employees describe fear of being labeled careless.
Supervisors receive informal praise for low incident counts.
participant_claims: Safety leaders say the reporting interface is easy to use.
researcher_interpretations: Fear and local supervisory norms may suppress reporting.
assumptions: Low reporting indicates low incident frequency.
